images.title: One more half roti
images.purpose: Set up the question: the table of halves stops at 5 × 1/2; what do the next rows say when one more half is added each time?
images.composition: A row of five half rotis on the left and one more half roti set apart on the right, with a wide gap, and one question line centred below.
images.exact_structure: Left: 5 half rotis of exactly the same size in one row, filled teal #0072B2, evenly spaced. Right: 1 more half roti of exactly the same size, filled amber #E69F00, with a grey #6B7280 plus sign between it and the row. No pairs joined into full rotis. One question line centred below. Exactly 5 teal halves, 1 amber half.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any filled in answer for the next row, or half rotis of different sizes
images.takeaway: Each new row adds one more half; count the halves.
images.description: Five teal half rotis marked 5 × 1/2, then one more amber half roti added, under the question Next row: ? × 1/2.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to count all the half rotis and write the next row of the table.

image_decisions.why: Five halves with one more added is the pattern to continue, shown without the next row filled in.
